B0200.title: Air Bag System Voltage Out of Range
B0200.description: The SRS module has detected that its supply voltage is outside the operating range, preventing reliable deployment readiness.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0205.title: HVAC Defroster Door Position
B0205.description: The HVAC control module has detected that the defroster door (windshield air outlet flap) does not reach the commanded position. Defrosting performance may be reduced.

causes.label: Door actuator motor failed or stripped

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0210.title: Rain Sensor Module
B0210.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rain sensor module on the windshield. Automatic wiper activation based on moisture detection is no longer available.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0220.title: Front Wiper Motor Speed Circuit
B0220.description: The body control module has detected that the front wiper motor speed feedback does not match the commanded speed. The motor may run only on one speed or not at all.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0223.title: SRS Indicator Lamp Circuit Malfunction
B0223.description: The SRS module has detected a fault in the airbag warning lamp circuit. The lamp may be inoperative, which prevents driver notification of stored faults.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0226.title: Headlamp Auto-Leveling Front Sensor
B0226.description: The body control module reports an implausible signal from the front ride-height sensor used by the automatic headlamp leveling system. Without valid input, the headlamp pitch cannot be corrected for vehicle load.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0228.title: Front Fog Lamp Circuit
B0228.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the front fog lamp circuit — typically an open bulb, blown fuse, or wiring fault. One or both fog lamps may not work.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0231.title: Front Marker Lamp Circuit
B0231.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the front side marker lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — the bulb may be burned out or the wiring is open.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0233.title: Rear Tail Lamp Circuit
B0233.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear tail lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0235.title: Brake Lamp Circuit
B0235.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the brake lamp circuit. One or more brake lamps do not match the commanded state — a safety-relevant fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0237.title: Backup Lamp Circuit
B0237.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the backup (reverse) lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state when reverse gear is engaged.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0239.title: License Plate Lamp Circuit
B0239.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the license plate lamp circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0240.title: Headlamp Switch Circuit
B0240.description: The body control module has detected an implausible state at the headlamp switch — for example simultaneous low and high beam request, or no signal at all. Lighting functions may be erratic.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0245.title: Driver Window Switch Circuit
B0245.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window switch circuit. The window may not respond to the switch in the driver door.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0247.title: Passenger Window Switch Circuit
B0247.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the passenger window switch circuit. Same fault profile as B0245 but for the passenger window.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0250.title: HVAC Air Temperature Internal Sensor Circuit
B0250.description: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the internal cabin air temperature sensor circuit, used to regulate climate control output.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0252.title: Driver Window Motor Down Circuit
B0252.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the driver window motor down-direction control circuit. The window may not lower correctly.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0255.title: HVAC Air Temperature External Sensor Circuit
B0255.description: A fault has been detected in the external (ambient) temperature sensor circuit used by the HVAC and instrument cluster.

causes.label: Ambient sensor failure (often behind front grille)

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0258.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 1 Circuit
B0258.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the actuator circuit for air mix door 1, which controls the proportion of warm and cool air in the airflow.

causes.label: Air mix door actuator motor failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0260.title: Interior Light Circuit
B0260.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the interior light circuit. The lamp does not match the commanded state — common cause is a stuck door switch causing battery drain.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0263.title: HVAC Air Mix Door 2 Circuit
B0263.description: A fault has been detected in the air mix door 2 actuator circuit, used in dual-zone HVAC systems for the passenger side.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0265.title: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit
B0265.description: Driver Door Lock/Unlock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.

causes.label: Door harness broken in hinge area

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0268.title: HVAC Mode Door 1 Circuit
B0268.description: The HVAC mode door 1 actuator circuit, which routes airflow between defrost, vents, and floor, has reported a fault.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0270.title: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0270.description: Passenger Door Lock Switch Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit. This affects central locking operated from this switch.

causes.label: Door harness broken in hinge area

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0272.title: Power Door Lock Switch Circuit
B0272.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the power door lock switch circuit. Central locking may not respond to the door switch.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0273.title: HVAC Recirculation Door Circuit
B0273.description: The HVAC recirculation door actuator circuit has reported a fault. Fresh/recirculated air switching may not work.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0274.title: Trunk Lid Release Switch Circuit
B0274.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the trunk lid release switch circuit. The trunk may not open via the interior or remote release.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0278.title: HVAC Defrost Door Circuit
B0278.description: A fault is detected in the HVAC defrost door actuator circuit; defrost airflow may not engage.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0283.title: HVAC Blower Motor Circuit
B0283.description: The HVAC controller reports a fault in the blower motor control circuit. Blower may run at incorrect speed or not at all.

causes.label: Blower resistor or final stage failed

symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0288.title: HVAC A/C Pressure Sensor Circuit
B0288.description: A fault has been detected in the A/C refrigerant pressure sensor circuit. The compressor may be disabled to protect the system.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0290.title: Rear Defrost Switch Circuit
B0290.description: The body control module has detected a fault in the rear window defroster switch circuit. The switch may be stuck or its signal does not reach the module — the rear defroster cannot be activated.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired

B0292.title: HVAC A/C Compressor Clutch Circuit
B0292.description: The HVAC controller has detected a fault in the A/C compressor clutch control circuit. The compressor may not engage.
symptoms: Warning light or symbol related to the affected system
Comfort or safety function impaired
